information_contract.development: 2023 opens only if calibration gate passes
information_contract.feature_availability: completed 5-minute bar only; prior EWMA denominators are shifted one bar
information_contract.state_filter: causal forward probability recursion; full-sequence Viterbi, smoothing and future labels prohibited
information_contract.state_semantics: the 2021 emission means are assigned once to accumulation, manipulation and distribution

market_contract.fatal_screen_provider: Binance Vision official USD-M monthly klines

model_contract.parameter_estimation: 2021 MiniBatchKMeans emission initialization plus chronological transition counts; no post-2021 refit

promotion_boundary: A development survivor is not ranked. It must be rerun unchanged on exact Bybit historical BBO/depth, actual funding, realistic latency/fills, continuous NAV and sequential 2024 opening.
research_question: Can one minimal causal ML model identify the accumulation-manipulation-distribution transition strongly enough to exceed realistic cost and materially close the 1% daily-growth gap?

strategy_contract.distribution: within three bars, distribution probability clears the same threshold and signed body plus taker flow point away from the raid
strategy_contract.raid: exactly one side exceeds the frozen box by max(5% of box range, 1bp) and closes back inside while manipulation probability clears the threshold
strategy_contract.stop: beyond the raid extreme plus the same structural buffer
